2610.06923.title: RadOnc-Agent: An LLM-Orchestrated Framework for AI Workflows Across the Radiotherapy Care Pathway
2610.06923.paper_summary: Artificial intelligence has advanced individual radiotherapy tasks, yet these capabilities remain separated across clinical stages, software environments and data modalities. This fragmentation contrasts with the longitudinal radiotherapy workflow from treatment decision-making through follow-up. Here we present RadOnc-Agent, an agentic artificial-intelligence framework that formalizes radiotherapy into four clinical phases and provides 26 callable functions through a conversational interface. A large-language-model controller maps clinical intent to schema-constrained calls, preserves patient and workflow context, and routes requests to specialist services. We evaluated system execution using 2,600 single-function requests (7,800 repeat executions), 200 prespecified synthetic cross-stage scenarios spanning four phases (600 executions), and 120 workflow instances from 60 de-identified patient records (360 clean executions) representing decision-to-planning and planning-to-adaptation. RadOnc-Agent selected the intended function in 98.79% of single-function executions, completed 96.50% of scripted cross-stage workflows, and completed 96.67% of real-patient workflow executions. In comparative ablations, removing longitudinal state reduced cross-stage completion from 96.50% to 84.00%, while disabling schema and identity validation increased mismatched backend dispatch from 0% to 95.28% in a replay/test evaluation. These findings establish the technical feasibility of an LLM-orchestrated architecture for coordinating heterogeneous radiotherapy capabilities and information across longitudinal workflows; they do not establish clinical correctness, clinical utility or prospective benefit.
2610.06923.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧已經推進了個別的放射治療任務，然而這些能力仍然在臨床階段、軟體環境和數據模式之間分散。這種碎片化與從治療決策到隨訪的縱向放射治療工作流程形成對比。在此，我們介紹 RadOnc-Agent，一個代理型人工智慧框架，將放射治療正式化為四個臨床階段，並通過對話介面提供 26 個可調用的功能。一個大型語言模型控制器將臨床意圖映射到架構約束的調用，保留患者和工作流程的上下文，並將請求路由到專業服務。我們使用 2,600 個單功能請求（7,800 次重複執行）、200 個預先指定的合成跨階段場景（涵蓋四個階段，600 次執行），以及來自 60 個去識別患者記錄的 120 個工作流程實例（360 次清潔執行）來評估系統執行。RadOnc-Agent 在 98.79% 的單功能執行中選擇了預期功能，完成了 96.50% 的腳本化跨階段工作流程，並完成了 96.67% 的真實患者工作流程執行。在比較消融中，移除縱向狀態使跨階段完成率從 96.50% 降至 84.00%，而禁用架構和身份驗證則使後端調度不匹配的情況從 0% 增加至 95.28% 在重播/測試評估中。這些發現確立了由 LLM 協調的架構在協調異質放射治療能力和信息跨縱向工作流程中的技術可行性；它們並未確立臨床正確性、臨床效用或前瞻性利益。
